name: Trusted Redirect
description: Allows redirects to external hosts that are configured as trusted.
project_description: Drupal core deliberately refuses to send a RedirectResponse to an external destination, because an endpoint that redirects wherever a request parameter names it is an open-redirect / phishing vector. Trusted Redirect re-enables external redirects for an administrator-maintained allowlist of hosts only. A response event subscriber, running before core's RedirectResponseSubscriber, inspects each RedirectResponse (including ones driven by the ?destination= parameter and a legacy ?trusted_destination= parameter); if the target URL's host exactly matches an entry in the configured trusted_hosts list it wraps the response in a core TrustedRedirectResponse so the redirect is allowed. The allowlist is edited at Configuration > Search and metadata > Trusted redirect and can be extended programmatically with hook_trusted_redirect_hosts_alter(). The optional trusted_redirect_entity_edit submodule adds a uuid-based entity edit route (/entity/{uuid}/edit) that resolves to the entity's normal edit form and forces that redirect to stay internal.
